text:
Aisha Patel: Heads-up — AcmeRetail is seeing repeat 5xx responses on their inference endpoint this week. Spikes observed Mon/Tue ~11:20-11:55 UTC. Need quick ownership and actionable follow-ups. @Liam Chen @Samir Gupta can you triage?
incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-ACME-5XX created by alerting (link: https://alerts.redwood.local/INC-2026-ACME-5XX).
Liam Chen: On it. Triage starting — grabbing traces, request/response samples, and GPU metrics. @Rosa Alvarez can you loop in the customer PM?
Samir Gupta: Initial glance shows bursts of KV cache evictions and several requests falling back to a CPU-quantized variant. Grabbing more traces now.
Rosa Alvarez: Will ping Acme PM and let them know we're investigating. Requesting any payload diffs or recent client SDK updates from them.
Liam Chen: Found repeated log frames pointing to model fallback and timeout:
```
ERROR 2026-03-19T11:23:12Z inference: request_id=abc123 status=500 reason="model_fallback_triggered" variant=redwood-7b-q latency_ms=12005
WARN  2026-03-19T11:23:12Z runtime: kv_cache_evictions=41 gpu_util=98%
```
incidents-bot: Canary fallback count = 23 triggers in last 2 hours; autoscale did not spin up extra GPUs (threshold=95%).
Samir Gupta: Proposed actions: reduce autoscale threshold to 85% for Acme dedicated pool, increase KV cache retention window, and add an alert for repeated fallback events. I'll open infra PR.
Liam Chen: Drafted PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/428 — changes autoscale policy + alerting. I'll run a canary deploy after merge and monitor.
Rosa Alvarez: Customer comms: emailed PM and offered a joint debug tomorrow 09:30 PDT. They agreed to share recent request samples and top error traces.
Aisha Patel: Ownership confirmed — Liam: eng triage + PR/canary; Samir: autoscale + runbook updates; Rosa: customer comms + sample collection; Aisha: postmortem + SLA review. Target: mitigation by EOD tomorrow. Tagging renewal impact? :thinking_face:
Rosa Alvarez: Not currently on renewal risk but monitoring. I'll escalate to AM if errors persist after mitigation.
Liam Chen: Acknowledged. Will post status updates and final root cause in this thread once canary completes. :thumbsup:
